newsitem.title: GERMANY: CSFB downgrades Deutsche Bank to hold.
newsitem.headline: CSFB downgrades Deutsche Bank to hold.

text.p: Credit Suisse First Boston (CSFB) said on Friday that it had downgraded its recommendation on Deutsche Bank to hold from buy.
CSFB said it had made the move because Deutsche looked fully valued, it had limitied shareholder-friendly consolidation options, and because it maintained a greater relative earnings risk.
"We also find market proxy 'bull cases' for Deutsche unconvincing," CSFB said in a research note.
It said, however, that it remained "overweight" on German banks as a sector, adding that it strongly preferred Dresdner Bank AG and Commerzbank AG banks to Deutsche.
CSFB said it believed Commerzbank was a "credible takeover target for a foreigner" and looked inexpensive based on fundamentals.
It said it saw 10 percent upside potential upside for Dresdner shares and 15 percent upside potential for Commerzbank shares before the end of 1997.
